### Safety and Limitations

- **Evidence gaps:** Many proposed benefits come from cell or animal studies, and DHM has relatively low bioavailability in the body.
- **Interactions and dosing:** Supplement doses vary widely, and potential interactions with medications or liver enzymes have not been fully mapped out in large human trials. items.title: Safety and Limitations
items.text: Evidence gaps: Many proposed benefits come from cell or animal studies, and DHM has relatively low bioavailability in the body. Interactions and dosing: Supplement doses vary widely, and potential interactions with medications or liver enzymes have not been fully mapped out in large human trials. Check with a healthcare professional before taking it, especially if you take medications or have liver concerns.
items.markdown:
